# Forge Portfolio Weighting (`forge-portfolio-weighting`)

Use this skill whenever designing, fitting, diagnosing, or validating **portfolio weights, sleeve carve-outs, idle-cash shares, or core volatility targets** in `qf-rust-engine` (`build_wix_walkforward_candidates` in `src/lib.rs` and `tools/qf-weighting-lab/`).

## 1. Non-Negotiable Estimation & Data Laws

1. **Daily-by-Climate Estimation vs. Quarterly Reporting (`N = 64` Quarters Rule):**
   - Full-history calendar quarters (`2011Q1–2026Q4`, $N = 64$) have $\text{SE}(\text{skew}) \approx 0.31$ and $\text{SE}(\text{ex-kurt}) \approx 0.61$. **Never fit weights, GARCH, or skew targets directly on quarterly observations.**
   - **Rule:** Estimate covariance, means, and drawdown constraints on **daily return streams conditioned by the decision-bar climate** (`daily_climate`, decided on session $t - 1$), and report quarterly distributions with stationary-block-bootstrap CIs.
   - **Quarterly Autocorrelation (`AC1 = -0.115` full book, `-0.216` core, `+0.103` overlay; all within $\pm 2/\sqrt{64} = \pm 0.25$):** There is zero evidence of quarterly persistence. **Never chase trailing 1–3 month sleeve returns ("strategy momentum")**—monthly re-weighting only pays turnover friction (`Frequency-Spread Law`). Use **yearly expanding-window refits** (`fit_end` = Jan 1 of year $Y$ minus a **21-session embargo**).

2. **Idle-Cash Headroom Law (`u_rem` & `settled_frac` by Climate):**
   - Measured on `COMPONENT_STREAMS_20261024.json` (`#54 BW_MT_A24_C10`):
     - **`C1_BULL_CALM`:** $\bar u_{\text{rem}} = 0.264$, $\overline{\text{settled}} = 0.223$ ($1,787$ sessions).
     - **`C2_BULL_INFLATION`:** $\bar u_{\text{rem}} = 0.103$, $\overline{\text{settled}} = 0.125$ ($921$ sessions).
     - **`C3_BULL_VOL_SHOCK`:** $\bar u_{\text{rem}} = 0.465$, $\overline{\text{settled}} = 0.280$ ($614$ sessions).
     - **`C4_BEAR_INFLATION`:** $\bar u_{\text{rem}} = 0.550$, $\overline{\text{settled}} = 0.443$ ($366$ sessions).
     - **`C5_BEAR_DEFLATION`:** $\bar u_{\text{rem}} = 0.802$, $\overline{\text{settled}} = 0.666$ ($287$ sessions).
   - **Implication:** In `C1/C2`, idle-cash valves have little room; the active levers are the stock-sleeve carve-out (`pit_xsec_base_weight`) and `vol_target`. In `C3/C4/C5`, idle-cash valves (`TMF`, `TSMOM`, `stress_bull_rev12`, `MultiTime Window A`, `SOXL Barbell`) govern the book.

## 2. The Three QF-WIX v1 Weighting Estimators

### A. Risk-Constrained Kelly (`Busseti–Ryu–Boyd 2016`, Risk-Matched & Pooled-Prior Shrunk)
- **Objective (in exact engine share space $\theta = [w_{\text{base}}, s_{\text{opp}}, s_{\text{tmf}}, s_{\text{ts}}, s_{\text{rev}}, s_{\text{mt}}, s_{\text{opt}}, m_{\text{core}}]$):**
  $$\max_{\theta \in [\theta_{\min}, \theta_{\max}]} \frac{1}{|\mathcal{A}_c|} \sum_{t \in \mathcal{A}_c} \log\big(1 + r_t(\theta)\big) \;-\; \sum_{k=1}^8 \frac{\kappa_k}{252}\,\big|\theta_k - \theta_{\text{prev},k}\big|$$
  subject to the **Risk-Matched Busseti–Ryu–Boyd Drawdown Constraints** on the stationary-bootstrap-augmented climate sample $\mathcal{A}_c$:
  $$\frac{1}{|\mathcal{A}_c|} \sum_{t \in \mathcal{A}_c} \big(1 + r_t(\theta)\big)^{-\lambda} \;\le\; \text{rhs}_\lambda(\theta_{\text{base}}), \qquad \lambda_{\text{ruin}} = \frac{\ln 0.05}{\ln 0.50} = 4.32,\quad \lambda_{\text{book}}(\beta) = \frac{\ln \beta}{\ln 0.70}$$
- **Critical Pitfalls & Non-Negotiable Rules:**
  1. **Why Risk-Match to the Base Policy (`rhs = base_risk`) Instead of Absolute `<= 1.0`:** When the core ETF exposure is held fixed ($m = 1$), the core ETF stream on its own can have $\frac{1}{T}\sum (1 + r_{\text{etf},t})^{-\lambda} > 1.0$ in volatile early samples. Never lower $\lambda$ to force feasibility, and **never scale infeasible sleeve shares toward zero** (because setting $w_{\text{base}} \to 0$ *removes* the unlevered 30-stock diversifier and pushes the portfolio back to 100% $3\times$ `TQQQ`, *increasing* tail risk!). Always set $\text{rhs}_\lambda$ to the hand-set base policy's risk on the same augmented sample and pull any infeasible point back **toward the base policy anchor** ($\theta(g) = \theta_{\text{base}} + g(\theta - \theta_{\text{base}})$).
  2. **Why Corner Solutions (`0` or `1`) Happen & How to Regularize Them:** Because valve weights are small relative to NAV, $\log(1 + r_t(\theta))$ is nearly linear in each share $\theta_k$, so unregularized RC-Kelly naturally jumps to corner solutions (`0.0` or `1.0`) and flip-flops across walk-forward years when a single climate has only $300–600$ sessions.
  3. **Hierarchical Pooled-Prior James–Stein Shrinkage (Never Shrink Toward a Full-Sample Policy):** Fit a **pooled all-climate RC-Kelly vector $\hat\theta_{\text{pool}}$** on all sessions $\le \text{fit\_end}$ ($4–5\times$ larger sample than any single climate), and shrink each climate's estimate $\hat\theta_c$ toward the hierarchical prior $\theta_{0,c}$ using the bootstrap variance $\text{tr}\,\widehat{\text{Var}}_{\text{boot}}(\hat\theta_c)$:
     $$\tilde\theta_c = \theta_{0,c} + B_c\big(\hat\theta_c - \theta_{0,c}\big), \qquad B_c = \operatorname{clip}\!\left(1 - \frac{\tau_{\text{mult}}\,\text{tr}\,\widehat{\text{Var}}_{\text{boot}}(\hat\theta_c)}{\|\hat\theta_c - \theta_{0,c}\|_2^2},\; 0,\; 1\right)$$
     Never shrink a walk-forward fit toward a policy that was tuned on the full `2011–2026` sample (that leaks future information into `Train`), and never inflate turnover penalties $100\times$ to mask estimation noise.

### B. Conditional-on-Invested Hierarchical Risk Parity (`HRP`, López de Prado 2016)
- **Pitfall of Unconditional Zero-Padded Sleeve Streams:** Event valves (`stress_bull_rev12` active $4.5\%$ of days, `MultiTime Window A` active $3.9\%$ of days) are zero on $>95\%$ of sessions. If you feed unconditional zero-padded streams into HRP, their sample variance looks artificially tiny ($\propto \text{fire\_rate}$), so inverse-variance allocation assigns $>90\%$ of weight to sparse valves and starves the core and 30-stock sleeve!
- **Rule:** Compute the pairwise-complete covariance matrix **conditional on being invested** (treating non-invested days as `NaN` when estimating per-sleeve variance and pairwise correlations, with Ledoit–Wolf constant-correlation shrinkage), run single-linkage clustering + quasi-diagonalization + recursive bisection, invert conditional weights into engine shares, and **route any clipped mass above engine caps into cash (T-bill sweep)—never renormalize clipped mass into other sleeves**.

### C. Banded State-Signature Allocation Index (Counting-Bloom Analogy)
- **State Key at Decision Bar:** $K_t = (\text{climate}_{t-1},\; b_{\text{vix}},\; b_{\text{slope}},\; b_{\text{dd}},\; b_{\text{breadth}})$ with pre-registered economic breakpoints:
  - $b_{\text{vix}} \in \{<16,\; 16\text{–}25,\; \ge 25\}$
  - $b_{\text{slope}} = \text{VIX9D}/\text{VIX3M} \in \{<0.90,\; 0.90\text{–}1.00,\; >1.00\}$
  - $b_{\text{dd}} = \text{QQQ DD}_{252} \in \{>-5\%,\; -5\%\text{ to }-15\%,\; <-15\%\}$
  - $b_{\text{breadth}} = \text{pct50} \in \{<35\%,\; 35\text{–}65\%,\; >65\%\}$
- **Known-State Membership Gate (`Zero False Negatives on Unseen States`):**
  - A marginal bin $(c, d, b)$ or joint cell $K_t$ is **`KNOWN`** iff it satisfies all three honest-$N$ gates in the fit window:
    1. Effective sample size $n_{\text{eff}} \ge n_{\min}$ ($60$ or $120$),
    2. Distinct contiguous episodes $\ge 8$, and
    3. Observed in $\ge 3$ distinct calendar years.
  - **Fallback Law:** If a joint cell fails the `KNOWN` gate (e.g., $n = 70$ days but only $2$ episodes in `2020-03` and `2022-06`), **the joint cell override is rejected**; allocation falls back to the **climate parent plus any marginal bin deviations $\tilde\delta_{c,d,b}$ whose individual marginal counters pass the `KNOWN` gate** (or pure climate parent if any marginal bin is unknown).

## 3. Ranking, Multiplicity & Retention Law

1. **Python-vs-Rust Reconciliation Gate (Load-Bearing Before Any Claim):**
   - For any dated `ClimatePolicySchedule`, the offline lab replica and `qf-rust-engine` must agree within $|\Delta\text{CAGR}| \le 0.5\text{pp}$ and $|\Delta\text{MaxDD}| \le 1.0\text{pp}$ on `Train` (and `0.000pp` when `core_mult = 1.0`). If a candidate's lab return diverges from Rust (e.g., $+1.8\text{pp}$ CAGR / $-2.4\text{pp}$ MaxDD gap), **reject the lab optimum immediately**—do not retain it on Rust Phase 5/6 numbers.
2. **Pre-Registered Family & Benjamini–Hochberg (`q = 0.10`, $m = 10$):**
   - Sort the $m = 10$ paired Politis–Romano validation $p$-values $p_{(1)} \le \dots \le p_{(m)}$ and reject only up to $k^* = \max\{i : p_{(i)} \le i \cdot q / m\}$.
   - Example: if the smallest $p$-value in a 10-candidate family is $p_{(1)} = 0.03 > 1 \times 0.10 / 10 = 0.010$, **zero candidates reject the null** ($p = 0.03$ and $p = 0.08$ both fail BH). When zero candidates pass the validation gate, **do NOT read the Sealed OOS window as a promotion gate**.
3. **Six Joint Retention Gates (All Required to Replace the Base Policy):**
   - **(G1)** $\Delta_{\text{Calmar}} > 0$ on both `Train` and `Val` at the `20 bps` friction floor + real NBBO, with 90% block-bootstrap CI excluding `0`,
   - **(G2)** BH-adjusted $p \le 0.10$ on `Val` and zero per-climate regression ($p < 0.10$ with MaxDD $>1\text{pp}$ deeper),
   - **(G3)** Passes all 5 Anti-Forever-Bull Nulls (`Null 2b` $\pi_{50}$ p5 MaxDD $> -50\%$, `Null 2c` survival),
   - **(G4)** Phase 6 $\Delta_v(\text{Calmar})$ shows **no component flipping sign** vs. the base attribution (never silently drop a hedge valve whose sign flipped just to make the candidate pass),
   - **(G5)** Net turnover $\text{Net}(f) > 0$ at the `20 bps` floor (never quote gross return when net is negative), and
   - **(G6)** **Single Sealed OOS Read (`2024H2–2026`):** Strict walk-forward schedule (frozen after `2024-01-02`) must have Sealed CAGR $\ge \text{base} - 0.5\text{pp}$ and Sealed MaxDD not deeper by $>1.0\text{pp}$. Never cite a "mechanical refit" (which refits inside `2025–2026`) as out-of-sample performance, and never take a second Sealed read after tweaking a hyperparameter.

4. **QF-WIX v2 Substrate Re-Basing & Consumed Sealed Reads (`pw_train_06`, `pw_val_05`, `pw_test_06`):**
   - **Why Share Re-Weighting Alone Cannot Fix Sleeve Identity (`pw_train_06`):** If a single sleeve key (`pead50_sec_res30`) lags in a specific climate (`+13.0%` in `C2` vs `+20.1%` for `clock21d_full`), adjusting scalar shares $\theta \in \mathbb{R}^8$ cannot recover the missing `+7.1pp` conditional return. **QF-WIX v2** adds a **pre-registered discrete sleeve menu per climate** gated by the `KNOWN` gate ($n \ge 120$, $\ge 8$ episodes, $\ge 3$ years) + hysteresis (2 consecutive fit years with $\Delta\text{Sharpe} \ge 0.10$); an unpenalized per-year free `argmax` across sleeves is **forbidden**.
   - **Re-Basing onto an Upgraded Substrate (`pw_val_05`):** When `build_wix_walkforward_candidates` is re-based onto `#74 BW_UPGRADED_SUBSTRATE_C10`, both the Busseti–Ryu–Boyd risk-matching $\text{rhs}_\lambda$ and the 50/50 hierarchical prior **must reference the new `#74` upgraded base per-climate spec**—never the old `#54` base and never a full-sample-tuned policy.
   - **Consumed Sealed Reads (`pw_test_06`):** Once the Sealed OOS window has been read across exploratory variants in a session, **further Sealed reads for that family are consumed** and a candidate may **never** be promoted solely because its Sealed delta is positive; the remaining uncontaminated gates are the **Rust 5-null battery (`Null 2b` p5 MaxDD $> -50\%$, `Null 2c` back-to-back bears), Phase 6 $\Delta_v$ with RC-Kelly/HRP re-fit weights, G5 $\text{Net}(f)$ at `20 bps`, and prospective forward quarterly $\Delta_v$**.
5. **Round 4–5 Volatility-Matched Cross-Sectional Risk Parity & `C3`-Only Barbell Boundary (`pw_val_06`, `pw_test_07`):**
   - **Why Removing `w_base` Fails While Volatility-Targeting the Stock Sleeve Succeeds:** Setting `w_base -> 0` and raising `TQQQ` `vol_target -> 0.50+` (Paradigm 1) **fails `Null 1` and `Null 2b`** because `TQQQ` beta is already saturated and the 30-stock sleeve supplies the `SPY`/`QQQ`-orthogonal Jensen alpha (`+10.27%/yr`). Conversely, keeping `w_base = 0.42 / 0.38` and **normalizing the 30-stock sleeve by its causal 20-day volatility to `target_vol = 0.36–0.42`** (`pead50_sec_res30_vt36_full`, `pead50_sec_res30_vt42_full`, net of T-bill financing and turnover spread) lifts Phase 6 $\Delta_{\text{XSec30}}$ from `+1.28pp` to **`+7.01pp/yr`** and pushes Full CAGR to **`41.65%` (`44.22%` NBBO-SP)**!
   - **Why Restricting the `SOXL` Option Barbell to `C3_BULL_VOL_SHOCK` Unlocks `+4.8pp` of `Null 2b` Headroom:** In `C4/C5` prolonged bears, repeated 7-DTE option premium decay deepens the `Null 2b` ($\pi_{50}$ 50%-Bear) p5 MaxDD by `-4.8pp` (`-51.62%` FAIL in `#94` vs **`-46.85%` PASS in `#96`** and **`-49.89%` PASS in `#98`**). Restricting the `SOXL` barbell to `C3_BULL_VOL_SHOCK` (`#96/#98/#99`) preserves `passes_anti_forever_bull == true` up to `vt = 0.42`, whereas `vt = 0.48` (`#100/#101`, `-51.38%` p5 DD) breaches the `-50%` `Null 2b` boundary and is rejected.
6. **Drawdown-Mitigation Round 1–3 Laws (`pw_val_07`, `pw_test_08`):**
   - **Why Daily Fast-Delever (`_afd` / `_afdc`, `#102–#109`) Over-Penalizes 21-Day Stock Sleeves vs. 21-Day Clock Vol-Targeting (`#111–#115`):** Applying daily `max(sig20, sig5, sig_down10)` de-levering (`#102/#103`) or a hard `<= 1.0x` trend cap (`#104/#105`) to a 21-day-rebalanced stock sleeve cuts exposure on 1-day/5-day pullbacks inside bull trends and Then **locks in the low scalar for up to 20 sessions** (until the next 21-day clock), costing `-3.4pp` to `-6.5pp/yr` CAGR (`40.82% -> 37.04%` in `#102` and `34.31%` in `#104`) while only improving Full MaxDD by `1.8–2.3pp`.
   - **The Superior Drawdown-Mitigation Law (`#111` & `#114/#115`):** Keep the stock sleeve's volatility scalar on its native **21-day rebalance clock (`Clock21`)**, and mitigate the two binding drawdown episodes structurally:
     1. **Episode 1 (`2015-07 -> 2016-01` `C5_BEAR_DEFLATION` Crash):** Set `c5_bear_deflation.pit_xsec_unused_cash_share = 0.0` (keep `C5` cash in `TMF` + `Window A Gap-Hold Reclaim` + T-bills, never catching `2016-01` / `2020-03` deflation knives with levered stocks) and gate `C4_BEAR_INFLATION` opportunistic stock deployment on **`pit_xsec_deploy_gate = Some((0.50, 1.00))`** (Bellwether 20d `QQQ Concordance >= 0.50` AND `VIX9D/VIX3M < 1.00`).
     2. **Episode 2 (`2023-07 -> 2023-10` `C2_BULL_INFLATION` Grind):** Enable `c2_bull_inflation.use_downside_sigma_floor = true` on the core ETF book and pair **`C1 vt = 0.42` (`pead50_sec_res30_vt42_full`) with `C2 vt = 0.36` (`clock21d_vt36_full`)** (`#114/#115`).
     - **Result:** `#111` achieves **`40.37%` Full / `42.59%` NBBO-SP CAGR** while cutting Full MaxDD to **`-31.68%` (Calmar `1.27`)**, cutting NBBO-SP MaxDD by **`-2.19pp` (`-36.66% -> -34.47%`, Calmar `1.24`)**, and improving `Null 2b` p5 MaxDD to **`-43.76%`**! And `#114` (`#115` at `20 bps` floor) achieves **`40.71%` Full (`$22.09M`) / `43.42%` NBBO-SP (`1.211` Sharpe, Calmar `1.23`)** while improving `Null 2b` p5 MaxDD by **`+5.17pp` (`-49.89% -> -44.72%`)**!
7. **Phase-Free Dynamic Drift-Band (`_db_full`) & 7-Tranche (`_tr7_full`) Vol-Scaling vs. Static 21-Day Clock (`pw_val_08`):**
   - **Why Static 21-Day Clocks Have Start-Day Phase Luck:** Sweeping all 21 starting offsets `offset in 0..21` of `(i - 21) % 21 == 0` moves standalone vol-targeted sleeve CAGR by `2.7–3.6pp` and MaxDD by `4–8pp`, with `offset = 0` ranking `3/21` (`~+0.8pp` sleeve-level phase luck). Furthermore, `_afd` (`#102`) lost `-3.8pp` CAGR not because of the clock, but because `max(sig20, sig5, sig_down10) * bw_drag` is upward-biased and forward 5d stock-sleeve returns are **highest** after `sig5/sig20 in [1.2, 1.5)` (`+0.73%/5d`, Sharpe `1.39` vs `+0.24%`, Sharpe `0.56` when `<0.8`)—so de-levering on 5-day volatility spikes sells the exact days that pay!
   - **The Phase-Free Dynamic Drift-Band Law (`mode == 3`, `_db_full`, `#119` & `#121–#123`):** Compute `tgt = clamp(target_vol / sig20, 0.75, 2.00)` every session using causal `sig20`, and update `scale = tgt` **iff** `(a) |tgt - prev_scale| >= 0.20 with >= 5 sessions since the last update` **OR** `(b) a causal regime boundary flips` (`QQQ` crosses `SMA200` or `VIX9D/VIX3M` crosses `1.02`).
   - **Result:** Replacing the static 21-day clock (`#118`: `40.69%` Full / `43.39%` NBBO-SP, `-34.34%` Full DD / `-35.27%` NBBO DD) with the **Phase-Free Dynamic Drift-Band (`#119`)** lifts Full CAGR to **`40.80%` (`43.53%` NBBO-SP, `1.216` Sharpe)** while **cutting Full MaxDD by `-2.19pp` (`-34.34% -> -32.15%`, Calmar `1.18 -> 1.27`), cutting NBBO-SP MaxDD by `-1.37pp` (`-35.27% -> -33.90%`, Calmar `1.23 -> 1.28`), and nearly doubling `Null 2c` 5-bear CAGR (`+3.27%/yr -> +6.06%/yr`)**! Cross-checking against the 7-Tranche rolling scalar (`#120`: `40.92%` Full / `43.76%` NBBO-SP, `1.220` Sharpe) and the Multi-Cadence 50/30/20 Blend (`#121`: `40.75%` Full / `43.59%` NBBO-SP, `63.47%` Sealed OOS) confirms complete phase invariance.
8. **Round 5–7 Formal Pareto Convergence & Co-Binding Drawdown Equality (`#124`–`#141`, `pw_test_09`):**
   - **Why `C2_BULL_INFLATION` `clock21d_vt30_db_full` (`vt = 0.30`) Solves the Binding 2023 Drawdown:** In `#122`–`#132`, `C2_BULL_INFLATION` used `clock21d_vt36_db_full`, which sat at the `2.0x` leverage clamp `57%` of `C2` days (median scale `1.89x`) on a `30%`-realized-vol sleeve, creating pure leverage drag during `2023-07-31 -> 2023-10-26` (`-32.15%` Full DD / `-33.11%` NBBO DD). Lowering `C2` sleeve target vol to `vt = 0.30` (`clock21d_vt30_db_full`) beats `vt36` at **14 / 14 expanding walk-forward fit ends (`2013..2026`)**, improves **4 of the top 12 drawdown episodes while worsening `0`**, and cuts the `2023` drawdown by **`-1.77pp`**, bringing both streams to **exact mathematical co-binding equality**:
     - **Full 2011–2026 Co-Binding Equality:** `2023-07-31 -> 2023-10-26` (`-30.38%`) $=$ `2015-07-20 -> 2015-08-25` (`-30.37%`, gap **`0.01pp`**!).
     - **Real NBBO-SP 2014–2026 Triple-Binding Equality:** `2023-07-31 -> 2023-10-26` (`-31.36%`) $=$ `2020-02-19 -> 2020-03-18` (`-31.36%`, gap **`0.00pp`**!) $\approx$ `2015-07-20 -> 2016-11-04` (`-31.23%`, gap `0.13pp`).
   - **Formal Convergence Proof:** Across `100` single-DOF perturbations around `#133/#137`, **zero perturbations** simultaneously achieve $\Delta\text{CAGR} \ge +0.25\text{pp}$, $\Delta\text{MaxDD}_{\text{Full}} \ge 0$, $\Delta\text{MaxDD}_{\text{NBBO}} \ge 0$, $\Delta\text{Null 2b} \ge -0.5\text{pp}$, and pass `forge-anti-phenomenon-overfit` Laws 1–7 (e.g., `#136 UCap16` fails `Null 3` at `p = 0.0220 > 0.0150` and deepens 2020 NBBO DD to `-31.70%`). The overlay is therefore **formally converged**.
